uncertainty: Not PDF/X and not color-managed for commercial press. It does not embed logos/images or custom fonts in this source package. Printer bleed/crop-mark requirements vary. The current checkpoint deliberately rejects non-ASCII card text because its standard PDF font is WinAnsi-limited; a licensed Unicode font should be embedded during integration for multilingual output.
